title: Personal Training Packages: deciding the total sessions credited at activation
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how the unlimited-tier grant and the membership signing bonus together decide the total number of sessions credited to a package at activation.

## Rule
Where the tier's own listed session count denotes unlimited use, the package is credited with unlimited use, and no signing bonus is added to it since there is no fixed count for a bonus to add to. Where the tier's own listed session count is a specific whole number, the package is credited with that number of sessions plus the signing bonus, where the signing bonus qualifies; where the signing bonus does not qualify, the package is credited with just that specific number of sessions.

## Points of judgement
The unlimited-tier determination is made first: only once the tier is confirmed to grant a specific whole number of sessions does the signing-bonus qualification add to that number. On the unlimited tier, the signing bonus plays no part in the amount credited at activation, regardless of whether the member's membership would otherwise qualify.
